text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: P1 — GPU pool 'gamma' eviction surge + autoscaler errors. Queue length > 11k, token throttles firing, 5xx rate up 7% last 5m. Auto-scale attempts failing with capacity handshake errors. Runbook: https://runbook/internal/incidents/2159876543

oncall-ryan: taking pager, jumping in. what's the immediate customer impact? any customer-facing 4xx/5xx spikes?

sre-anya: seeing elevated 429/503 on /v1/generate across multiple tenants. latency p50 -> 450ms -> 1.2s, p95 -> 2.8s. Throttles already at token-level. Some tenants reporting timeouts.

eng-runtime-lee: looking at serving telemetry — continuous batching backpressure and prefix cache misses. There's a recent config rollout that bumped `continuous_batching.min_batch_size` to 8 and set `prefix_cache.ttl_seconds` to 0 in gamma pool. suspect regression.

infra-jamal: autoscaler logs show repeated "could not provision: insufficient gpus in region" and handshake timeouts when starting new nodes. also saw pool eviction spikes from OOM throttles on a subset of pods.

prod-mgr-olivia: corp support flagged two paying customers with elevated errors. CS engaged. we should scope customer impact for comms.

customer-success-sam: customers A & B noticed request failures and impact to chat sessions. They're requesting ETA. please keep me posted.

eng-runtime-lee: quick mitigation ideas: 1) rollback the batching config rollout to previous commit 2) re-enable prefix cache (ttl 600s) 3) raise autoscaler soft limit (temporarily) and enable burst capacity 4) route high-qps customers to a warm fallback model variant.

oncall-ryan: prioritize rollback + prefix cache fix. Jamal/Anya can you prep scaling change after rollback?

infra-jamal: on it. I can bump pool max_replicas to 40 (was 20) for immediate headroom, but need approval for cost.

sre-anya: approving temporary headroom increase for incident window. do it. I'll watch for downstream overloads.

eng-runtime-lee: rollback command: 

```
redwoodctl rollout rollback service/gamma-batching-config --to-revision=20260302-rc1
```

and fix prefix cache: 

```
redwoodctl config set pool/gamma prefix_cache.ttl_seconds=600
```

eng-runtime-lee: also patch continuous batching params back: 

```
continuous_batching:
  enabled: true
  min_batch_size: 2
  max_batch_delay_ms: 30
```

infra-jamal: executing rollback now. applying prefix_cache change. will also request scale-up to 40.

infra-jamal: (exec) `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/gamma-batching --to-revision=5`

infra-jamal: (exec) `redwoodctl pool update gamma --max-replicas=40 --enable-burst=true`

eng-runtime-lee: ++ watching KV/prefix cache hit rate. before fix hit-rate ~4%, after TTL change should go > 70% for common prefixes.

sre-anya: adjusting rate limiter to soften token-level failfast so we don't cascade: lowering throttle aggressiveness by 30% for 15m.

prod-mgr-olivia: Sam, send interim note to impacted customers: acknowledging degradation, mitigation in progress, ETA 20-30m. keep message short.

customer-success-sam: drafting now. will post and ping once sent.

eng-runtime-lee: metrics update: queue length dropping from 11k -> 6k after rollback + prefix cache restore. 5xx rate dropping. p95 latency from 2.8s -> 1.1s.

oncall-ryan: good. Jamal, keep autoscaler headroom up until we confirm stability. Anya, keep watch on eviction/OOMs — if OOM persists, we may need to roll a different image with memory tuning.

infra-jamal: leaving max_replicas=40 for now. burst enabled. no further provisioning errors after reconfig — nodes allocated and pods scheduling.

sre-anya: eviction rates dropping. prefix cache hit-rate increased to ~76%. continuous batching queueing deltas look healthy.

prod-mgr-olivia: customer update sent. they replied asking for root cause and prevention. we'll follow with postmortem.

eng-runtime-lee: preliminary root cause: batching config rollout increased min_batch_size -> increased per-request queuing and reduced effective throughput for mixed short/long requests; combined with prefix_cache.ttl_seconds=0 (effectively disabled) causing KV cache thrash and more memory pressure; resulting in pod evictions and autoscaler inability to converge due to rapid churn.

oncall-ryan: incident status -> mitigated. queue decreasing, throttles backing off. keeping page open for monitoring for 1h.

customer-success-sam: customers acknowledged interim. asked for postmortem and SLA check.

eng-runtime-lee: next steps assigned: 1) full postmortem and timeline (lee) 2) revert validation gating to prevent batching changes without canary/metric checks (eng/runtime + sres) 3) add autoscaler backoff/rescue logic to prevent oscillation (infra) 4) add canary to prefix cache rollouts (eng)

prod-mgr-olivia: adding ops task to roadmap to reduce blast radius.

oncall-ryan: closing pager thread in 20m if stable. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: P1 -> mitigated. final status: queue normalized, autoscaler stable, rollback applied. Postmortem assigned: eng-runtime-2159876543.
